name: react-dnd-kit-tailwind-shadcn-ui
summary: Example accessible Kanban board built with React, @dnd-kit, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with drag-and-drop and keyboard support.
description: A reference implementation of a drag-and-drop Kanban board that stays usable with a keyboard and assistive technology thanks to @dnd-kit's accessibility features. Columns and cards are styled with Tailwind CSS and built from shadcn/ui primitives; the repo includes a developer guide and a live GitHub Pages demo.
contains: built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
